info.title: workspace API
info.description: The public HTTP API of a workspace installation. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer wos_…` (an API key from Admin › Integrations; a personal key acts as the person who made it) or a signed-in session token. Every call is checked against the caller's permissions, exactly as in the web app. The same operations are available to AI agents through the MCP endpoint `/api/mcp` (docs/integrations/mcp.md).

get.summary: My tasks, or one project's tasks
get.description:
Without `projectId`: tasks assigned to the caller plus their own unassigned to-dos (`scope=owned`: tasks they own), 50 per page, by due date. With `projectId`: that project's top-level tasks the caller may read, 200 per page. Needs a person (a personal API key), except with `projectId`.

Permission: `task.read`.

get.summary: What the agent did in one step, a line per action
get.description:
Kinds: `start` (an attempt begins), `say` (the agent's words), `tool` (an action and what it acts on), `result` / `error` (how it ended), `note`, `draft` (the answer as it is written). Without `after`: the latest 400 lines; with it: the lines since, which is how to follow a step at work. `more` says another page waits.

Permission: `task.read`.
